texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]上的整个生物圈进行了密集的采样与研究后，[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称这种物质并不是该星球上的原生物质，而是一种来源未知的侵入性真菌生命形式。这种真菌以生物物质为食，使周边的植物窒息而亡并笼罩整个地区。

任何打算来这颗星球定居的人都必须将这些外来真菌烧毁——目前尚不清楚这些真菌能不能被彻底清除。
texts.en:
After intense study and sampling of the growth blanketing entire biospheres on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the substance is not native to the planet, but rather an invasive fungal lifeform of unknown origin. The fungus feeds on biomatter, choking out existing plant life and enveloping terrain.

Any future settlers on the planet would have to deal with routinely burning back the exofungus - it is unknown at this point if it can be entirely eradicated.

summary.text:
# 奇异的植物毯子 / Bizarre Blanket

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:402-421; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3884 (distar.105)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。尺寸大于15的非城市宜居星球可能生成（1级，权重10）；生成时星球立即获得 exofungus（外来真菌）修正。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on a non-urban habitable planet larger than size 15 (level 1, weight 10); on spawn the planet immediately gets the exofungus modifier.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.105“侵入性外来真菌”：覆盖大陆的生长物是来源不明的侵入性真菌，吞噬生物质、压制本地植物；未来殖民者需要不断焚烧清理。奖励社会学研究，记录标本 invasive_exofungus。

distar.105 "Invasive Exofungus": the blanketing growth is an invasive fungus of unknown origin that feeds on biomatter and chokes native plants; future settlers will have to keep burning it back. Rewards society research; specimen invasive_exofungus.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。

No empire-specific option differences.

Checked the anomaly definition and distar.105. The modifier is added on spawn, regardless of investigation.
